what_changed:
Arch Linux AUR: the package is published from this repo on each release (PR #29).
• aur/PKGBUILD is built and tested in a clean Arch container before it's pushed

Fixes Windows in-app updates actually applying.
• Wait for the elevated installer to finish before relaunching
• Start the installed Program Files binary instead of a local/old path

Sorting, shuffle and recently viewed (PR #28).
• Sort the Library and every collection by date taken or date added; each view remembers its own order
• File size and rating on Immich 3.2+, relevance for smart search, and file-manager orders in folders
• Albums follow their Immich order (saved with album.update); shared albums can sort by likes and comments; trash by date deleted
• Shuffle any view; Explore gets View all for recently added and a local Recently viewed list
• Last viewed sort; remembering can be paused or cleared in Appearance (this computer only)

Fixes in-app updates on Windows and Linux.
• Installer downloads no longer abort after 30 seconds
• The updater picks the package for your CPU architecture
• Snap builds leave updates to the Snap Store

Cache: download all library thumbnails from Settings -> Appearance.

Explore: album, person and other photo grids load more as you scroll (PR #27).

Jump back to the top of long photo grids (PR #26).
• Home / End jump to top or bottom; clicking Library again scrolls to the newest photos; a back-to-top button appears after scrolling

User profiles (issue #24).
• Create, rename, delete and switch saved accounts; caches and sync state are isolated per profile
• Hide the account switcher when only one profile exists

Thumbnails load faster when scrolling (PR #23).
• Cached thumbnails show right away; on-screen tiles load first; the viewer preview is prioritized

Favorites: add or remove from the viewer and the right-click menu (PR #22).

Settings: the back button moved into the settings header (PR #21).

Appearance: custom palette text, muted text and border colors (PR #20).

Sidebar: People, Favorites, Archive, Albums, Tags, Folders and Trash (PR #19).
• Grouped under Main, Collections and Tools; denser buttons, tree guide lines and expand animation
• Albums, tags and folders have overview pages; Trash restore / delete permanently / empty

Custom HTTP headers for Immich requests (proxy auth and similar).

Packaging: CMake options for distro builds (PR #14); Arch Linux AUR package in the README (PR #15).

Library performance on large libraries (PR #13).

Internationalization (issue #17).
• Follow the system language or choose one in Appearance; catalogs update from GitHub automatically
• Polish and Simplified Chinese (PR #18); German and French with English fallback

Also:
• Combo boxes no longer change value when scrolling over them
• Community docs: Code of Conduct, Contributing, Security, issue and PR templates
• CI and Windows packaging fixes so icons and resources ship correctly
• README: live Star History chart (light/dark)
